# Bakshi Bros

4.8

[1191 reviews from Google](https://bakshi-bros.localo.site/#reviews)

Your one-stop shop for Luggage bags, school bags, suitcases, and travel essentials in Chandigarh! Explore premium brands like American Tourister, Samsonite, Skybags, Carlton London, Wildcraft, and Tommy Hilfiger. From durable school backpacks and trendy cabin bags to polycarbonate trolleys and trekking bags, we cater to students, travelers, and professionals. Enjoy:
✅ Affordable Prices on VIP luggage bags, Skybags suitcase, Safari travel bags, and stylish school bags.
✅ Bag Repair Services in Chandigarh + authorized service centers for American Tourister, Skybags, Carlton, and more.
✅ Convenient Locations: Visit our stores in Chandigarh, Mohali, or Panchkula for suitcase shop near me needs.

🛍️ Shop Now for trolley bags and school bags.

## Customer's reviews

Bakshi Bros is an excellent place to buy quality bags in Chandigarh. The staff is very cooperative, professional, and helpful, making the entire shopping experience smooth and comfortable. They patiently show different options and guide customers according to their needs.

The store offers a wide variety of bags, including travel bags, backpacks, office bags, and premium options. One of the highlights is the availability of genuine leather bags, which are of very good quality and durability.

Overall, it is a reliable shop with good variety and honest dealing. Anyone looking for quality bags with good service should definitely visit Bakshi Bros in Sector 19C Main Market.

~ Bhanu G


I bought set of 3 VIP’s black color bags from them in Feb-22 before moving to London. One of the bag’s zip got loose during the luggage transfer. By chance, we had an opportunity to go India in Jun-22(On my employer’s expense 😅) and my wife called them the day we reached Chandigarh and they got the zips changed the very next day. I was honestly surprised by their service and response and it felt like worth spending 12k for the bags buying from their shop and their commitment to help their customers.

Thank you, If we need more bags(i hope we wouldn’t, already got 7 bags😂), your business will be our first preference because of our experience with your business. Thank you.

~ Mayank P
